name: Oren Farhi
title: Senior Front End Engineer / Tech Lead
summary:
As a seasoned front-end engineer with over two decades of experience, I specialize in crafting high-performance, scalable, and user-friendly web applications.
With a deep understanding of software architecture and a mastery of cutting-edge technologies like TypeScript, React, ChakraUI (styled with emotion), CSS, React Query, Redux & RTK Toolkit, Next.js, and Node.js, I deliver robust solutions that meet the most demanding requirements.
Utilizing AI as a tool with my expertise in CSS and libraries like Tailwind & PandaCSS ensures a seamless and visually appealing user experience across all devices.
I'm the author of "Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX".
